user.title: Connect to OutBack MATE3s
user.description: Connect directly to the MATE3s using Home Assistant's shared Modbus connection. The default MATE3s installer password is 1732; if your installer changed it, enter the current password for write controls.

reconfigure.title: Update MATE3s write password
reconfigure.description: Enter the current MATE3s installer/write password used to authorize Modbus register changes.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to communicate with the MATE3s over Modbus TCP.
error.not_outback: The device responded, but the expected OutBack MATE3s SunSpec blocks were not found.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant logs.
error.invalid_write_password: Write password must contain 1 to 16 ASCII characters.
